reviewScope: Independent read-only review of 14 actual PNGs across the original three-workflow run and the targeted adult-pose5 rerun. No browser launch, source edit or test rerun by this reviewer.

initialRun.failure: Adult pose5 hit the original 180000ms timeout before its candidate capture. Original failure evidence is retained.

observations: The candidate removes the baseline's narrow dark seam beside the jaw.
The large rounded neck end is buried into the shirt, creating a clearer head-to-neck transition.
The head, supporting hand and camera framing appear unchanged.
The exposed shirt opening remains angular. This is a future visual refinement opportunity, but the isolated neck correction improves this view.

acceptedPairs.review: The large exposed rounded neck end disappears into the shirt, with a more natural chin-to-neck transition. Head and hand framing appear unchanged.

Paired 320px high-contrast views are visually near-identical. No new visible break or overlap is apparent. This view supports preservation of the accessible display, rather than demonstrating the subtle neck change.

overall: All three planned matched visual pairs are accepted. Adult pose5 validation is supplied by the targeted successful rerun; the initial timeout remains documented.
